### Label

PADI6-related oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest 16 and maternal-effect disorder

### Synonyms

oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest 16, PREIMPLANTATION EMBRYONIC LETHALITY 2, early embryonic arrest

### Synonym type

exact

### Definition

PADI6-related oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest 16 and maternal-effect disorder is an autosomal recessive female infertility disorder marked by early embryonic arrest  and female infertility. 

### Parent term

inherited oocyte maturation defect MONDO0014769

_No response_
